text:
hey lets build a tool for authoring the storyline. We will want to do this:

setup some conditional state machine board, that each object in the tree has a shape like:
title
id
author
questline
fromNPC
desc
reward
dependents
constraints
events with cutscene, location, order of events, dialog, etc.
am i missing anything
resolution: Companion to req_0911 (same build). The user's quest-object schema (title/id/author/questline/fromNPC/desc/reward/dependents/constraints/events with cutscene/location/order/dialog) was mapped against the existing ruled substrate and confirmed near-1:1 with game/missions MissionDef + game/story; the genuine gaps were named and grounded in V22 rulings (outcomes-not-single-reward, fail/expiry gates, person|position binding, offer channel, effect-events for PROTECT-THE-ZERO, branch/exclusivity, P2 numbers, provenance tag, per-step typed location) plus the one non-field requirement (live affordance validation against the queryable world). The build landed slice 1: the conditional state-machine board over that substrate, adding the first-class requires gate that makes constraints/dependents real edges. See req_0911 for the file-level detail and verification.
